scripts.check:pcb-03: tsci check source pcb-03/design/pcb-03.circuit.tsx && tsci check pin_specification pcb-03/design/pcb-03.circuit.tsx && tsci check schematic-placement pcb-03/design/pcb-03.circuit.tsx && tsci check netlist pcb-03/design/pcb-03.circuit.tsx && tsci check placement pcb-03/design/pcb-03.circuit.tsx && bun run test:pcb-03
scripts.test:pcb-03: bun run build:pcb-03 && bun test pcb-03/design tools/export_kicad_schematic.test.ts
scripts.export:kicad:pcb-03: sh -uc 'test -n "$STILLAIR_HANDOFF_STAGE"; tsci export pcb-03/design/pcb-03.circuit.tsx --format kicad_zip --output "$STILLAIR_HANDOFF_STAGE/pcb-03.kicad.zip"; unzip -q "$STILLAIR_HANDOFF_STAGE/pcb-03.kicad.zip" -d "$STILLAIR_HANDOFF_STAGE"; bun run tools/export_kicad_schematic.ts dist/pcb-03/design/pcb-03/circuit.json pcb-03.circuit.kicad_sch'
scripts.handoff:pcb-03: bun run manifest:pcb-03 && python3 tools/tscircuit_handoff.py normalize dist/pcb-03/design/design-manifest.json --augmentation pcb-03/design/kicad-augment.json -o dist/pcb-03/design/design-manifest.normalized.json && python3 tools/tscircuit_handoff.py stage dist/pcb-03/design/design-manifest.normalized.json --augmentation pcb-03/design/kicad-augment.json --build-command '["bun","run","build:pcb-03"]' --export-command '["bun","run","export:kicad:pcb-03"]' --production-dir pcb-03 --staging-root dist/pcb-03/handoff
